decision.summary: Within allowed context [570,653], E shows a prolonged low plateau starting around index 590 and an abrupt upward shift near 605–606. Neither the onset nor the return of a temporary offset is fully confirmed: the interior is sustained but not strictly flat, and no opposing return is observed before index 653. N and U show no coherent opposing motion that would confirm a temporary offset. Hence both candidate intervals are uncertain.

intervals.observation: E-axis sustained low plateau (~-5 to -8) from index ~590 to 610, with N and U showing variable but non-opposing trends; no clear return observed within allowed context
E-axis abrupt upward shift at ~605–606 (from ~-8.25 to ~-7.42), followed by continued E values near -7 to -6 through 617; no opposing return observed before end of allowed context (653)
